description: This Java class 'WorkEffortContentWrapper' implements the 'ContentWrapper' interface to manage and render content related to work efforts in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve content by type, ID, and description, with caching support, and handles content rendering for display purposes.

classes.name: WorkEffortContentWrapper
classes.description: A class that manages retrieval and rendering of work effort content, supporting caching and content type filtering.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves content as text for a given content ID, with caching and encoding options.

methods.name: getContentId
methods.description: Returns the content ID for a specific content type.

methods.name: getContentName
methods.description: Returns the content name for a specific content type.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the from date timestamp for a specific content type.

methods.name: getDataResourceId
methods.description: Returns the data resource ID associated with a content type.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of content texts for a specific content type.

methods.name: getTypeDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of a content type.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves content by content ID with options for cache and encoding.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContentAsText
methods.description: Static helper to get content as text, with various overloads for context.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContentTextList
methods.description: Static method to get a list of content texts for a work effort and content type.

methods.name: getFirstWorkEffortContentByType
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the most recent work effort content of a specific type.

methods.name: makeWorkEffortContentWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create a new WorkEffortContentWrapper instance from a work effort and request.
